name: RoutingSlip
summary: Attaches the itinerary to the message, so that a sequence of steps can vary per message without a central participant deciding it.

roles.name: RoutingSlip
roles.summary: The participant that computes the itinerary and attaches it. The route travels with the message, so no step needs to know the next one and no process manager holds the state.

roles.name: Itinerary
roles.summary: The ordered list of steps carried on the message, and the position within it. It is on the message rather than in a store, which is what makes the sequence self-describing and a failure mid-route diagnosable from the message alone.
